chapter_name: Long Composition: Letters, Paragraphs, and Emails
learning_objective: 🎯 Learn to build brilliant paragraphs, write proper letters, and send modern emails like an absolute professional!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A great paragraph is like a tasty burger! The top bun is your Topic Sentence that introduces the main idea. The meat and veggies are the middle sentences giving cool details, and the bottom bun is your Concluding Sentence that wraps it up neatly.
We write Formal Letters to principals or managers using very polite, respectful language. We write Informal Letters to our friends and family using fun, casual, and friendly language!

Emails are super-fast digital letters. The most important part of an email is the 'Subject Line' which tells the reader exactly what the email is about in just three to five words, before they even open it!

fun_activity.title: 📧 The Principal's Email
fun_activity.instructions: Write a short, polite email to your imaginary school principal. Fill in the 'To' and 'Subject' lines, and ask respectfully for a two-day leave because you are attending your cousin's exciting wedding!

quick_recap: ⭐ A good paragraph stays on one single topic and has a clear beginning, middle, and end.
⭐ Formal letters follow strict rules for schools and businesses, while emails need a clear Subject line so the reader knows what it is about.
